achieved.claim: Consolidated business segment EBITDA was up 6% year-on-year at INR 8,762 crores this quarter.
Hindalco India upstream EBITDA was up 14% year-on-year at INR 4,832 crore with 45% margins.
Aluminum Downstream delivered a quarterly EBITDA of INR 233 crores, up 55% year-on-year.
Achieved 126% recycling of Bauxite residue, 105% recycling of ash, and 126% recycling of Copper slag.

pushback.concern: Consolidated net debt increased significantly by nearly $2 billion despite good profits.
Aluminum EBITDA per ton remained flat despite a $300-$400 per ton increase in LME prices.
Novelis leverage reaching high 4s and potential breach of consol net debt to EBITDA threshold.
Copper demand destruction due to price rise and whether EBITDA will fall substantially.

output.tone_why: Management expressed strong confidence in underlying business strength, project timelines, and margin recovery.
